en.topic_title: Explainer: Hong Kong’s national security crackdown – month 74
en.topic_summary:
In August, two high-profile activists were found guilty in a national security case along with the organisation they once led – the now-dissolved Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China.



Chow Hang-tung, former leader of the group that organised Hong Kong’s annual Tiananmen vigils, was escorted to Court of Final Appeal on June 8, 2023. File photo: Lea Mok/HKFP.



For over 30 years, the group and numerous pro-democracy activists organised an annual vigil
